protocol.edit_scope: Subtract only selected natural contribution at the final input is; no generated-position edits; later layers compute normally.
protocol.residual_definition: Output of each complete decoder block, after both residual additions, before the next block; L35 is before final RMSNorm and unembedding. L28 is an unchanged pre-edit control.
protocol.comparison: Same input token position and text in all conditions. Only the first-answer distribution is evaluated; no autoregressive text divergence.
protocol.downstream_gate_evaluation: Offline gate encoders on captured layer-specific post-attention residuals, before native post_attention_layernorm; checkpoint input standardization retained. Native later MLPs run normally.
protocol.gate_primary_precision: CPU FP64, with independent FP32 gate/mask comparison

runtime.dtype: BF16 model; FP32 MOLT edit with one BF16 cast
